verdict.rationale: A desktop OS could plausibly offer automation tooling with versioning and rollback, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about creating, versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations. A community mention of btrfs as a default filesystem is adjacent at best and does not document any automation rollback capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
